ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (PrepTime.cs:18-21) == cost 1 / POWER / UNCOMMON / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<PrepTimePower>(4m)` (PrepTime.cs:14) == `_power_amount = 4`, stored in the slot `magic_number` reads.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<PrepTimePower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["PrepTimePower"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (PrepTime.cs:25) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, PrepTimePower, self._power_amount, applier=ctx.player)`. No animation on either side. Presentation, folded in: the Vigor hover tip (16), which is the power the card ultimately grants each turn.
